metadata.title: IndologyScholars: Russian Indological Research Archive — Zograf and Roerich Readings Conference Corpus (2004–2026)
metadata.description: A structured, open-access dataset of 1,385 conference presentations, 276 scholar profiles, and 1,411 author participations drawn from the published programs of the Zograf Readings (St. Petersburg, 2004–2026) and Roerich Readings (Moscow, 2005–2025; the 2005 program enters by a copy preserved in correspondence with the organizer, classified manually under the same closed vocabularies), with a curated historical prosopographical layer of pre-contemporary Russian Indologists. Includes normalized speaker identities, institutional affiliations with explicit provenance tagging, thematic classification (L1/L2), three-level argument-scale coding (G1–G3), video-record mapping, and external authority identifiers (Wikidata, ORCID, OpenAlex). Formats: SQLite (conferences.db), JSON (site_data.json), 100+ analytics CSV exports, RDF/Turtle knowledge graph, Frictionless Data Package manifest, and a SHA-256 snapshot manifest. Companion data paper: Gasūns, M. (2026), Russian Indological Research Archive: A Conference Corpus for Prosopography, Research Data Journal for the Humanities and Social Sciences (submission pending).
